She is also a certified IGBC Accredited Professional (IGBC AP). Beyond architecture, Moksha is an avid traveler who enjoys documenting the character of different places. With a keen interest in the built environment, she particularly enjoys photographing heritage buildings and historic districts. She believes that architecture and travel are deeply interconnected, each enriching the understanding of the other.
